ranking_policy: Verification-and-anchoring scan for mini-ork, a task OS for coding agents whose verdict is EXECUTION-ANCHORED: a candidate change is judged by what the code actually did (tests, live observable surfaces, metamorphic invariants, oracle replay), never by a model's opinion, and an LLM judge may only veto, never approve. Rank 2026 papers by how directly their VERIFICATION technique could be adopted by one of mini-ork's verification surfaces: execution/test-based verification, oracle construction and validity auditing, metamorphic and property-based testing, invariant/contract checking, formal and certificate-based verification, verifier-gated self-improvement, reward-hacking and specification-gaming detection, LLM-judge reliability, calibration and abstention, and ground-truth-anchored evaluation. Papers that build or audit the accept/reject machinery itself rank above papers whose verification is a side experiment; papers matched by multiple topics rank above single-topic matches; break ties by citation signal (citation_count, influential_citation_count) and recency.
